metaDescription: Components, visual foundations and accessible interaction examples for GitHub Profile Generator.
title:
A little structure.
A lot of personality.
description: A shared visual language for profiles of every kind. Calm surfaces, clear choices and room for your work to speak.
demoNotice: Component showcase. Interactive examples use local state and do not create or publish a profile.

foundations.title: Foundations
foundations.description: A neutral canvas with a purposeful green accent. Every color follows the selected light or dark theme.
foundations.typeBody: Short descriptions and generous spacing help each section feel easy to read.
foundations.spacingBody: Spacing follows a 4 px grid. Consistent gaps keep controls comfortable and content connected.

buttons.title: Actions
buttons.description: One clear primary action, supported by quieter alternatives. Every button keeps a comfortable touch target.
buttons.disabledReason: Publishing is unavailable in this component showcase.
buttons.feedback: Example selected: {action}. No profile has been changed.
buttons.hint: Try an action to see its local feedback.

fields.title: Fields & guidance
fields.description: Visible labels, useful hints and explicit errors keep the next step understandable.
fields.name: Display name
fields.nameHint: Use the name you want people to see.
fields.contactError: Enter a complete link, such as https://www.linkedin.com/in/your-name.
fields.contactHint: An intentional error example; this form does not submit.
fields.bioValue: I build useful things for the web and enjoy learning with other developers.
fields.bioHint: Describe what you enjoy building or what you are exploring.
fields.disabledHint: Disabled in this demonstration to show an unavailable field.
fields.requiredHint: Fields marked with * are required in this example.

badges.title: Tags & status
badges.description: Technologies, context and status stay readable. Status always includes a label and can include an icon.
badges.caption: A technology tag communicates a choice, never a proficiency score.

modules.title: Modules & choices
modules.description: Start with what matters to you. Optional sections can add detail without making a short profile feel incomplete.
modules.controlsDescription: These controls only change the sample beside them.
modules.technologiesHint: Add tools you want to share.
modules.activityHint: An optional block with illustrative data.
modules.compactHint: Give the same content a tighter rhythm.
modules.disabledReason: This control demonstrates the disabled state.
modules.bio: I enjoy building thoughtful web experiences and learning by making things.
modules.activityNote: Illustrative data, not connected to a GitHub account.
modules.footer: A profile can be complete with just an introduction.

feedback.title: Feedback & loading
feedback.description: A loading placeholder preserves the layout. A clear message makes the waiting state understandable.
feedback.loadingHint: Static demonstration of a loading module.
feedback.readyBody: Your selection stays visible and easy to review.
feedback.motion: The pulse animation respects your reduced motion preference.

footer: Built around clear choices, at your own pace.
